svg.text: DIMENSIONS IN CSS PX, MEASURED IN A 1280 PX VIEWPORT.
SLOTS ARE PLACEHOLDERS; COPY AND CONTENT ARE OUT OF SCOPE.
HUG = SIZED BY CONTENT. FLEX = TAKES REMAINING SPACE. FILL = PARENT WIDTH.
CODES REFER TO THE TABLES; DERIVED VALUES ARE GIVEN AS FORMULAS.
VALUES NOT FOUND IN THE SOURCE ARE [TBD]. GRAYSCALE ONLY.
